reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: is_obligation_safe has active non-test callers at market.move:332 and :424. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; attack entry points (refresh_usd_price, borrow) are permissionless public functions, not a trusted source. Gate 3: market.move is explicitly in-scope and oracle price manipulation is a listed focus area. An attacker can trigger this via a Sui PTB by calling the permissionless refresh_usd_price<CollateralCoin> to stamp a fresh collateral price, then immediately calling borrow<MarketType, DebtCoin> while the debt asset oracle is at near-maximum staleness (up to 5 s), causing is_obligation_safe to underestimate debt value and allowing the attacker to borrow more than their collateral properly supports.
